newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kingmaker to issue 40 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Kingmaker to issue 40 mln new shares.

text.p: Kingmaker Footwear Holdings Ltd said on Monday its controlling shareholder, King Strike Ltd, had agreed to place 30 million existing shares to third parties and to subscribe for 40 million new shares.
The footwear maker said King Strike would place 30 million existing shares, or 6.94 percent of the company's share capital, at HK$0.80 per share.
Following the placement, King Strike would subscribe for 40 million new shares, or 8.47 percent of the enlarged share capital, at a price equal to the placing price after expenses.
King Strike's stake in Kingmaker would be reduced to 55.02 percent on completion of the deal, from 57.8 percent.
Kingmaker said net proceeds raised from the new issue of about HK$31 million would be used to increase its production facilities in China's Zhuhai and for general working capital.
King Strike is owned by directors of Kingmaker, with Mickey Chen holding 57.25 percent, Chen Cheng-hsiung at 24.47 percent, Helen Huang at 16.67 percent and Lee Kung at 1.61 percent.
Shares of Kingmaker rose HK$0.04 to HK$0.91 in late morning.
